user.title: Connect to an xTool device
user.description: Select a device found on your network, or enter an IP address manually.

manual.title: Manual connection
manual.description: Enter the IP address of your xTool laser cutter.

discovery_confirm.title: xTool device discovered
discovery_confirm.description: An xTool laser **{name}** was discovered on your network. Do you want to set it up?

pair_confirm.title: Pair with the device
pair_confirm.description:
The device at {host} only accepts paired clients (newer V2 firmware, e.g. M2 40.141.012.01.ht05).

Click **Submit**, then press the button on the device when it asks you to confirm the connection.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure xTool device
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address, or pair the device again.

data.pair_again: Pair again (button press on the device)

pick_model.title: Pick xTool model manually
pick_model.description:
Auto-discovery could not identify the device — discovered name `{name}`, firmware `{firmware}`.

Pick the model and firmware line from the list — pick the V2 entry if your firmware is recent (40.x range with the new communication framework), V1 otherwise.

If your model isn't listed, please [open an issue]({issue_url}) and include the discovered name and firmware so it can be added.

progress.press_button:
Waiting for the button press on the device at {host}…

Press the button on the device now to confirm the connection.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the IP address and ensure the device is powered on and connected to WiFi.
error.udp_no_reply: No UDP discovery reply from the device on port 20000. Verify the IP, that the device is powered on and on the same subnet, and that no firewall blocks UDP broadcasts.
error.unknown_model: The device replied to discovery but its model name is not recognised by this integration. Please open an issue with the reported name.
error.protocol_failed: The device was identified but the protocol handshake failed. The device may be busy (XCS / xTool Studio open) or the firmware version is unsupported.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing timed out — the button on the device was not pressed in time. Try again.
error.pairing_blocked: The device refused to pair right now (another client may be pairing). Close XCS / xTool Studio and try again.
error.pairing_required: The device needs to be paired again.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.
abort.udp_no_reply: No UDP discovery reply on port 20000 — check that the device is online and on the same subnet.
abort.unknown_model: The discovered device model is not recognised by this integration.
abort.protocol_failed: Protocol handshake with the device failed — close XCS / xTool Studio and try again.
abort.pairing_timeout: Pairing timed out — the button on the device was not pressed in time.
abort.pairing_blocked: The device refused to pair right now. Close XCS / xTool Studio and try again.
abort.wrong_device: A different device answered at this address.

data_description.power_switch_entity_id: Select a switch that controls the laser's power supply (e.g. a smart plug). Leave empty if not applicable.
data_description.enable_firmware_updates: When enabled, the firmware update entity can install new firmware. When disabled, it only shows that an update is available.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the integration polls the device for state updates. Lower values are more responsive but generate more network traffic.
data_description.firmware_check_interval: How often the integration queries the xTool cloud for firmware updates.
data_description.stats_poll_interval: How often lifetime statistics are refreshed (M2008). Slow-changing values, default is 5 minutes.
data_description.dongle_poll_interval: How often connected Bluetooth accessories are queried (M9098).

overlay_colors.name: Overlay colors
overlay_colors.description: Colors of the P2 camera overlays.

confirm_updates.title: Enable firmware updates?
confirm_updates.description:
Flashing firmware carries risk.

- Do **not** power off the device during an update — an interrupted flash can brick the laser.
- Ensure stable Wi-Fi between Home Assistant and the laser.
- The device will reboot automatically when the flash completes.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Moves the laser's focus as xTool Studio's manual focus does: by a signed step (repeated a number of times), or straight to a material thickness. Stops at 0 or 150 mm. Refused while a job runs, while the laser focuses or measures, or when it reports an error.

step.name: Step
step.description: Signed step in mm: positive moves up, negative moves down.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: How many times to apply the step.

thickness.name: Thickness
thickness.description: Material thickness to focus on, in mm (0-150), as Studio shows it.

camera.name: Camera crop
camera.description: Sets the part of the work surface the straightened main camera shows, in mm, and refreshes its picture. Give any of the four values; the others stay. A width or height of 0 shows the whole photo that way.

crop_width.name: Crop width
crop_width.description: Width of the area in mm (20-460), or 0 for the whole photo across.

crop_height.name: Crop height
crop_height.description: Height of the area in mm (20-460), or 0 for the whole photo down.

crop_center_x.name: Crop center X
crop_center_x.description: Center of the area in mm from the center of the calibrated area; positive moves right.

crop_center_y.name: Crop center Y
crop_center_y.description: Center of the area in mm from the center of the calibrated area; positive moves down.

move.name: Move
move.description: Moves the P2's laser head as xTool Studio's move controls do: to an X and Y position, or by signed steps (repeated a number of times). An axis given neither stays where it is. Stops at 0-620 by 0-308 mm. Refused unless the laser is idle. Moves run one at a time, in the order asked.

x.name: X
x.description: Position to move to, in mm from home (0-610); X grows to the right.

y.name: Y
y.description: Position to move to, in mm from home (0-305); Y grows toward the front.

step_x.name: Step X
step_x.description: Signed step in mm: positive moves right, negative moves left.

step_y.name: Step Y
step_y.description: Signed step in mm: positive moves toward the front, negative toward the back.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: How many times to apply the steps.

device_id.name: Laser
device_id.description: The P2 whose laser head moves.

feeder_clamp.name: Clamp feeder material
feeder_clamp.description: Clamps the material in the X1's conveyor feeder for its thickness, as xTool Studio does when a thickness is entered in feeder mode. Refused unless a feeder is fitted and the laser is idle. Release material lets it go again.

material.name: Material
material.description: Rigid (wood, acrylic) or flexible (leather, felt), as Studio's material hardness.

bluetooth_accessory_not_found.message: A paired Bluetooth accessory did not show up within 2 minutes. Put it in pairing mode (on the SafetyPro AP2, hold the power button for 5 seconds until the Bluetooth light blinks) and press again.

focus_wrong_entity.message: This entity is not an xTool focus height.

focus_needs_step_or_thickness.message: Give either a step or a thickness.

camera_wrong_entity.message: This camera cannot be cropped. Choose an xTool main camera that the laser calibrates.

camera_value_out_of_range.message: {field} is {value} mm, but this camera allows {minimum} to {maximum} mm.

camera_needs_a_value.message: Give at least one crop value.

move_needs_a_value.message: Give an X or Y position, or a step.

move_wrong_device.message: Pick an xTool P2: only its laser head can be moved.

feeder_wrong_device.message: Pick an X1 with a conveyor feeder.

feeder_not_fitted.message: The feeder did not move: no feeder is fitted.

feeder_laser_not_idle.message: The feeder did not move: the laser is not idle.
